aws/storage/aws-storage-gateway-cached-v: Storage Gateway cached volume: primary data in S3 with frequently accessed data cached locally on-premises.
aws/storage/aws-storage-gateway-file-gat: Storage Gateway file gateway: provides file-protocol access to cloud storage from on-premises environments.
aws/storage/aws-storage-gateway-noncache: Storage Gateway stored (non-cached) volume: full dataset kept on-premises with asynchronous backups to AWS.
aws/storage/aws-storage-gateway-tape-gat: Tape Gateway: virtual tape library replacing physical backup tapes with storage in S3 and Glacier.
aws/storage/aws-storage-gateway-virtual-: Virtual tape library (VTL): collection of virtual tapes presented by Tape Gateway to existing backup software.
aws/storage/aws-storage-gateway-volume-g: Volume Gateway: presents iSCSI block volumes on-premises backed by cloud storage and EBS snapshots.
